title: If you're doing even one of these, your ad account is bleeding money ...
description: If you're doing even one of these, your ad account is bleeding money 🤦‍♂️
transcript: Five ways to ruin your meta add account. Number one, killing ads based on emotions. One small dip doesn't mean your ad is dead, wait at least a week. Number two, scaling too fast. Going from $50 a day to $500 overnight isn't scaling, it's a recipe for disaster. You'll reset the learning phase and spike your CPAs. Number three, only testing variations. If your ad is already flopping and you change the color scheme, nothing meaningful is going to happen. Go deeper and test different hooks, different emotions, different offers. Number four, letting one creative carry the whole account. If you have nothing prepared for when ad fatigue eventually kicks in and the audience stops buying, your sales will tank. Number five, ripping off your competition's ads on a one-to-one scale. You don't really know their business margins, their offer, process, or backend. Take inspiration, but stay unique.
